Desc: Executable code. The number of Benign Code Blocks determines the success of the emergency repair.
Name: Benign Code Blocks

Desc: Collect the required number of Benign Code Blocks to complete the project.
Name: Logic Block Endpoint

Desc: Can be collected after entering the Pursuit Phase. When picked up, defeats enemies on contact for a short duration.
Name: Troubleshooting Mode

Desc: Pick it up to move faster for a certain amount of time and turn all enemies on the map to running shoes. Touch the shoes to refresh the duration.
Name: Sprinter

Desc: The most common and easiest error to debug. Patrols along a fixed route.
Name: Syntax Error

Desc: A monster in the world of bytes. It moves fast in a straight line but doesn't look very flexible.
Name: Eclipser

Desc: A monster in the world of bytes. It can slow down things within a certain range around it. You will be automatically slowed down when you get close to it.
Name: Ooze

Desc: Running Shoes (1 = Duration (To Be Deleted), 2 = Speed Upon Consumption, 3 = Stack Speedup)
Name: Shoes

Desc: Pick it up to create a clone of yourself to attract the enemies. It will stun any enemy it touches and eat Byte Crystals just like you.
Name: Clone

Desc: Touch to teleport between breakpoints of the same color.
Name: Loop Breakpoint

Desc: Resembles a creature from a certain classic game. Patrols along a fixed route and grows longer after consuming Code Blocks.
Name: Stack Overflow

Desc: The glutton of the error world. Starts by rapidly devouring Benign Code Blocks. Slows down after eating its fill and has no fixed patrol route.
Name: Memory Leak

Desc: When picked up, slows down all errors, making troubleshooting easier.
Name: Step Debugging

Desc: When picked up, moves faster for a duration.
Name: Quick Traversal
